关键词: American Stock Transfer & Trust Company, LLC
主要内容: Impac Mortgage Holdings Inc approved and executed a Second Amendment to the Tax Benefits Preservation Rights Agreement on April 27, 2016. The amendment, which was filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, extends the Final Expiration Date of the agreement from September 2, 2016, to September 2, 2019. The amendment also stipulates that the Rights will no longer be exercisable as of September 2, 2016, if the Company’s stockholders do not approve the amendment at the 2016 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. The amendment was executed between Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc. and American Stock Transfer & Trust Company, LLC, as rights agent. The document was signed by Ron Morrison, who holds the title of EVP and General Counsel.

股票实体.名称: American Stock Transfer & Trust Company, LLC
